correctness.rationale: All admissible x_k+δ are nonnegative, making 0<s≤1; C is Hilbert–Schmidt and A a positive contraction. The weighted block entries equal U_k diag φ(x_j−x_k−δ); φ≤exp(−|u|/2) yields the off-diagonal Schur bound ε, while diagonal block singular values are ≥ma_d, so B is a surjective bounded isomorphism. The exact integer-orbit geometric Gram sum has diagonal blocks in [m²/2,M²/(1−e^(−2))] and off-cluster norm ≤η, proving the claimed frame. Disjoint 2d-windows around centers imply |n_A−rN_T|≤r. Finite diagnostic ran 27 independently oriented finite-section cases; it cannot replace the general proof.

value.rationale: Combines critical finite-sensor sampling density with surjectivity and uniform stable reconstruction, a stronger property than frame preservation. It allows arbitrary large temporal gaps, r nearly identical eigenvalues per spectral cluster and arbitrary time-varying sensor mixing while controlling stability by explicit constants independent of the total number of modes. The construction directly addresses a motivated gap between general necessary bounds, multiorbit original-frame criteria and scalar critical-basis theorems; it is not a restatement of a scalar or equal-spacing case.
